title.zh: Morning Minute: Robinhood Misses, But Crypto Beats and Robinhood Chain Soars
title.en: Morning Minute: Robinhood Misses, But Crypto Beats and Robinhood Chain Soars

current_state.zh: Crypto markets rebounded ahead of FOMC as BTC ETF inflows continued, while Ripple secured final OCC approval for a national trust bank, Google previewed crypto custody for banks, and Robinhood beat crypto expectations despite missing overall earnings estimates.
